axi_axil_adapter_wr.summary: AXI4 to AXI-lite write adapter: a 4-state FSM accepts AXI write bursts, tracks address/beat count, splits or merges data width, issues one AXI-lite write per beat and returns one merged response.

blocks.name: Write FSM
blocks.description: Sequences address accept, data beats, per-transfer response and burst completion

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DATA/DATA_2/RESP controller sequencing address accept, data transfer and response collection

anchors.name: burst_active_reg
anchors.why: Burst still active; decides RESP returns to DATA or finishes to IDLE

anchors.name: convert_burst_reg
anchors.why: Selects merge path STATE_DATA_2 vs narrow pass-through after response

anchors.name: first_transfer_reg
anchors.why: Marks first transfer so its bresp is captured

anchors.name: last_segment_reg
anchors.why: Last narrow segment of a split beat; chooses DATA vs DATA_2

blocks.name: Burst tracking
blocks.description: Beat counter and address/size/ID holding registers for the active burst

anchors.name: burst_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beat count loaded from awlen, decremented per accepted beat

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Current burst address, incremented per beat; feeds next awaddr and lane shifts

anchors.name: burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched awsize controlling address increment per beat

anchors.name: master_burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Output transfer size used for address stepping and merge boundary

anchors.name: id_reg
anchors.why: Latched AXI write ID returned on bid

blocks.name: Width conversion datapath
blocks.description: Splits, replicates or merges slave data and strobes into AXI-lite write data

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Wide data held while splitting or merging across segments

anchors.name: strb_reg
anchors.why: Write strobes held alongside data_reg for split/merge

anchors.name: m_axil_wdata
anchors.why: AXI-lite write data, shifted/replicated/merged from slave write data

blocks.name: AXI slave write port
blocks.description: AXI4 AW/W/B channels with registered ready and response outputs

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-address valid; starts a new burst in IDLE

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Slave write-address ready from s_axi_awready_reg, asserted in IDLE

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-data valid; accepted beats advance burst and address

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Slave write-data ready from s_axi_wready_reg, gated by master wvalid

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data beats copied, replicated or packed into AXI-lite write data

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Burst start address loaded into addr_reg and master awaddr

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-response valid raised when burst finishes in RESP

anchors.name: s_axi_bresp
anchors.why: Merged response: first or any error AXI-lite bresp of the burst

blocks.name: AXI-lite master write port
blocks.description: Registered AXI-lite AW/W outputs and B response handshake

anchors.name: m_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI-lite write address per single transfer, from awaddr or addr_reg

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite address valid issued for each transfer, cleared on awready

anchors.name: m_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite write-data valid, gates slave wready

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite response valid; completes a transfer in RESP

anchors.name: m_axil_bready
anchors.why: AXI-lite response ready, asserted when slave response channel free

axi_axil_adapter_rd.summary: AXI4-to-AXI-Lite read adapter: an FSM accepts an AXI read burst, then issues one AXI-Lite read per beat with incrementing address, returning data with ID and rlast; width split/merge paths for mismatched buses.

blocks.name: Read controller
blocks.description: FSM, beat counters and address/ID registers converting bursts into single reads.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Controller state IDLE/DATA/DATA_READ/DATA_SPLIT sequencing burst-to-single-read conversion.

anchors.name: burst_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beat counter loaded from arlen, decremented per beat; zero ends burst.

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Current burst address incremented by beat size, drives next AXI-Lite araddr.

anchors.name: id_reg
anchors.why: Latched arid returned on rid for every beat of the burst.

anchors.name: burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched arsize determining address increment per beat.

anchors.name: master_burst_reg
anchors.why: Master-side beat counter for narrower AXI-Lite merge path.

anchors.name: master_burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Master-side transfer size used for address stepping in width conversion.

blocks.name: Width conversion buffer
blocks.description: Data and response holding for split or merge when bus widths differ.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Holds wide AXI-Lite read data for split/merge width conversion.

anchors.name: resp_reg
anchors.why: Holds accumulated read response for split/merge paths.

blocks.name: AXI slave read port
blocks.description: AR and R channels of the AXI4 slave side.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid starting a new burst in IDLE.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: AXI read address ready, asserted in IDLE when no lite request pending.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Burst start address loaded into addr_reg and m_axil_araddr.

anchors.name: s_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Burst length loaded into burst_reg beat counter.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read data valid per returned beat.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: AXI read data ready from master, clears rvalid.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Returned read data from s_axi_rdata_reg, sourced from m_axil_rdata.

anchors.name: s_axi_rlast
anchors.why: Marks final beat when burst counter reaches zero.

blocks.name: AXI-Lite master read port
blocks.description: AR and R channels of the AXI-Lite master side.

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read request valid issued per beat by FSM.

anchors.name: m_axil_arready
anchors.why: AXI-Lite address accept, clears arvalid.

anchors.name: m_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Per-beat AXI-Lite read address from m_axil_araddr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read data valid, captured into slave response.

anchors.name: m_axil_rready
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read data ready asserted in data states when slave output free.

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read data forwarded to s_axi_rdata.

axi_axil_adapter.summary: AXI4 to AXI-Lite bridge wrapper: instantiates independent write (axi_axil_adapter_wr) and read (axi_axil_adapter_rd) adapters that split AXI bursts into per-beat AXI-Lite transactions.

blocks.name: Write path adapter
blocks.description: AXI write burst to per-beat AXI-Lite writes with merged response

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid into write adapter

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Write adapter accepts AXI write address

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI burst write start address into write adapter

anchors.name: s_axi_awlen
anchors.why: Write burst length controlling number of AXI-Lite writes

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data beats into write adapter

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Merged write response valid back to AXI master

anchors.name: m_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Per-beat AXI-Lite write address from write adapter

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite write address valid

anchors.name: m_axil_wdata
anchors.why: AXI-Lite write data from write adapter

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite write response valid into write adapter

blocks.name: Read path adapter
blocks.description: AXI read burst to per-beat AXI-Lite reads with ID and rlast

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid into read adapter

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: Read adapter accepts AXI read address

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI burst read start address into read adapter

anchors.name: s_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Read burst length controlling number of AXI-Lite reads

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data beats returned to AXI master

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read data valid

anchors.name: m_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Per-beat AXI-Lite read address from read adapter

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read address valid

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read data into read adapter

anchors.name: m_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read data valid
